title: Run the opt-in credentialed provider contract checks from a command
goal: VC-201-051's mastery target begins with 'Execute opt-in credentialed and fixture-backed checks for authentication, streaming, tool calls, embeddings, usage and errors'. The checks exist: probe_credentialed_opt_in is public in crates/susi-gemi/src/provider_contract.rs and the module is exported from lib.rs. But the only two references to it anywhere in the tree are its own definition and that module declaration - no CLI command, no admin path, no daemon path calls it, so nothing executes the checks and no operator can run them.
